title: vitis mappia
intro: Vitis mappia, commonly known as the Himalayan grapevine, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region of Asia. It has been used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular protection, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential applications.
